figurative_meaning_en: To proceed stealthily without making noise or being noticed
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে রাতে পা টিপে চলে ঘরে ঢুকল যাতে কেউ না জানতে পারে।
বাচ্চারা খেলতে খেলতে পা টিপে চলছে যেন মা শুনতে না পায়।
example_sentences_in_english: He tiptoed into the room at night so that no one would notice.
The children are sneaking around playing so that their mother doesn't hear.
note: This idiom reflects everyday caution in Bengali rural and semi-urban life.
